Salt-and-pepper noise removal

This animation illustrates neighborhood filtering of an 8-bit grayscale image containing salt-and-pepper noise.
  • Min filter: removes isolated bright salt pixels.
  • Max filter: removes isolated dark pepper pixels.
  • Median filter: removes both types while usually preserving edges better.
The red box shows the current neighborhood. The middle panel shows its pixel values. The right panel reveals the filtered result as the window moves across the image.

Interpretation

A 3x3 median filter selects the middle value after sorting the neighborhood. It can suppress both salt and pepper noise without the directional bias of min/max filters. Larger neighborhoods remove larger noise clusters, but also remove more fine detail.
